plan.title: Reclaim the .eval namespace for version-eval results

narratives.Description: The .eval directory was named for evaluation but became the triage working-set cache. Move the triage cache to a dedicated namespace so the version-eval results store can own .eval, de-conflicting the two concepts.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Update the triage cache path resolver module to write to a dedicated triage-cache directory instead of .eval.
- Add a migration for existing cache files and tests asserting triage loads and writes resolve to the new path.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want the triage cache moved off .eval, so that the version-eval results store can own that namespace without collision.
narratives.Traces: #1703 namespace cleanup; .eval currently holds candidates.jsonl and summary-history.jsonl.

narrative.Acceptance: The triage cache resolver returns the dedicated triage-cache path instead of the .eval directory.
When triage runs after migration, it loads candidates from the new cache path.
The results store persists to .eval and no longer collides with the triage cache.

expected_outputs: Triage cache relocated off .eval to a dedicated namespace
Migration for existing triage cache files

references.title: Issue #1703: RFC: measuring directive version-over-version performance -- tiered framework-eval model
